[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/ECR_TAGGING_GUIDE.md#image-naming-format]

### Image Naming Format

Your images will be tagged in this format:

```text
{ECR_REGISTRY_URL}/{ECR_REPOSITORY_NAME}:{tag}
```

For example:

```text
707203271462.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/pfe-pg-dev-us1-cm-ecr-platform-shared:mkdocs-platform-staging-abc123
```
page_texts.5:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/ECR_TAGGING_GUIDE.md#1-git-commit-strategy-recommended-for-production]

#### 1. Git Commit Strategy (Recommended for Production)

```bash
# Environment variable configuration:
ECR_IMAGE_TAG_STRATEGY=git-commit
ECR_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX=mkdocs-platform

# Generated tags:
mkdocs-platform-dev-a1b2c3d   # For dev environment
mkdocs-platform-prod-a1b2c3d  # For prod environment
```

#### 2. Git Branch Strategy

```bash

ECR_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX=mkdocs-platform
```

### Configuration Files

Use the provided environment templates to configure your ECR settings:

```bash
# Copy the ECR/EKS template for your environment
cp env-eks-template.env .env.eks.staging

# Edit the file to set your specific values
# ECR_REGISTRY_URL=707203271462.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
# ECR_REPOSITORY_NAME=pfe-pg-dev-us1-cm-ecr-platform-shared
# ECR_IMAGE_TAG_STRATEGY=git-commit
# ECR_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX=mkdocs-platform

# Load the environment variables
source .env.eks.staging
```

[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/ECR_TAGGING_GUIDE.md#build-and-push-to-your-ecr-repository]

#### Build and Push to Your ECR Repository

```bash
# Set environment variables (or load from .env file)
export ECR_REGISTRY_URL=707203271462.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
export ECR_REPOSITORY_NAME=pfe-pg-dev-us1-cm-ecr-platform-shared
export ECR_IMAGE_TAG_STRATEGY=git-commit
export ECR_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX=mkdocs-platform

# Build for dev environment
python _helpers/scripts/build_docker.py --docker-env=dev

# Build and push for dev environment
python _helpers/scripts/build_docker.py --docker-env=dev --push

# Build with custom tag
python _helpers/scripts/build_docker.py --docker-env=prod --tag=v1.0.0 --push
```
page_texts.12:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/ECR_TAGGING_GUIDE.md#override-ecr-settings-via-command-line]

#### Override ECR Settings via Command Line

```bash
# Override repository (useful for different projects in same ECR registry)
python _helpers/scripts/build_docker.py \
  --repository=pfe-pg-dev-us1-cm-ecr-platform-shared \
  --docker-env=dev \
  --push

# Override tag strategy
python _helpers/scripts/build_docker.py \
  --tag-strategy=timestamp \
  --tag-prefix=docs-platform \
  --docker-env=prod \
  --push
```

[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/ECR_TAGGING_GUIDE.md#multiple-images-in-same-repository]

### Multiple Images in Same Repository

Since you're using a shared ECR repository, you can differentiate images using prefixes:

```bash
# For different applications in the same repository:
ECR_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX=mkdocs-platform    # Results in: mkdocs-platform-dev-abc123, mkdocs-platform-prod-abc123
ECR_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX=api-service         # Results in: api-service-dev-abc123, api-service-prod-abc123
ECR_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX=web-frontend        # Results in: web-frontend-dev-abc123, web-frontend-prod-abc123
```
page_texts.14:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/ECR_TAGGING_GUIDE.md#viewing-images-in-ecr]

### Viewing Images in ECR

After pushing, you can view your images:

```bash
# List all images in your repository
aws ecr describe-images \
  --repository-name pfe-pg-dev-us1-cm-ecr-platform-shared \
  --region us-east-1

# List only mkdocs-platform images
aws ecr describe-images \
  --repository-name pfe-pg-dev-us1-cm-ecr-platform-shared \
  --region us-east-1 \
  --image-ids imageTag=mkdocs-platform-staging-latest
```
page_texts.15:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/ECR_TAGGING_GUIDE.md#cicd-integration]

### CI/CD Integration

In your GitHub Actions workflow, the tagging will work automatically:

```yaml
env:
  ECR_REGISTRY_URL: 707203271462.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
  ECR_REPOSITORY_NAME: pfe-pg-dev-us1-cm-ecr-platform-shared
  ECR_IMAGE_TAG_STRATEGY: git-commit
  ECR_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX: mkdocs-platform

steps:
  - name: Build and push to ECR
    run: |
      python _helpers/scripts/build_docker.py --docker-env=staging --push
```

This will automatically generate a unique tag for each commit and push it to your ECR repository.
page_texts.16:
[.tooling/components/apps/mkdocs-platform/docker/ECR_TAGGING_GUIDE.md#best-practices]

### Best Practices

1. **Use git-commit strategy for production** - Ensures traceability
2. **Include environment in prefix** - Easy to identify environment-specific images
3. **Use semantic versioning for releases** - e.g., `--tag=v1.2.3-production`
4. **Enable lifecycle policies** - Automatically cleanup old images to save costs

Your ECR repository will now contain images with clear, traceable tags that make it easy to deploy specific versions to EKS.
